notes: Private garden verandah. Room dimensions on the reference sheet include walls. The shared porch is 16 ft deep by 14 ft wide overall, with a 2 by 1 ft return around the ICU. A vehicle threshold ramp connects the east verge to house level. The 14 ft kitchen platform is measured between finished walls. The stair arrives in the open east hall with a private door to the west TV room. The hall opens directly to the north terrace. The north terrace measures 50 ft east–west by 15 ft north–south and covers the ICU court, east lawn and part of the reading loggia. Its columns and beams are conceptual and require structural design.
